name: Play! Pokémon Prize Pack Series Two

releases.name: Play! Pokémon Prize Pack Series Two

description.text:
Play! Pokémon Prize Packs are six-card packs that Pokémon sends to Play! Pokémon stores to hand out at in-store events such as Leagues, League Challenges and League Cups; stores with more active events get more packs. Every card is a reprint that keeps its original set number and is marked with the Play! Pokémon logo.

Series Two, released on 19 January 2023, holds 154 cards from Battle Styles through Brilliant Stars, plus Sword & Shield Black Star Promos, some Items from the Sword & Shield base set, and the basic Energy printed for Brilliant Stars.
